name: Nanaka
message: 「So you managed to make up with Mako-chan, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, I see, that's great news.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, your little sister figure is practically my little sister figure too, y'know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you and Mako really that close, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm, we've just bumped into each other at the shopping district a few times? Like when Mako-chan was working her part-time job.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it's like we kind of share an understanding, or something.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, we both understand the value of hard work.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Synn-sama wants to keep the squirt all to himself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say?! So you really are!」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you jump to that conclusion!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've had her calling you 'big brother' the whole time!」

name: Synn
message: 「That was just how things turned out, or whatever.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And you're even dressed up like a plushie!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sorry, but I'm only interested in Ria-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, this isn't my hobby!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, whether you're a lolicon or whatever, I've got no intention of judging Synn-sama's kinks.」

name: Synn
message: 「If Paqy had a tongue, I'd be ripping it out right now...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Threatening ruthless torture to keep your underlings in line--classic Synn-sama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, not like Synn's got the guts to actually do anything to Mako-chan anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, I wouldn't really care though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, with you and Mako-chan, there's no way things would ever end up like that anyway.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why, you ask? To observe big brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, Big Brother, you said it yesterday, didn't you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「To spend time together and keep watching you the whole time.」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why I ran super hard after my morning part-time job ended!」

name: Synn
message: 「It seems my phrasing was a bit misleading, though!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, did you lie to me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then there's no problem with me being here, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, there's a deep chasm between our understandings!」

name: Melphas
message: 「It appears to me that Your Highness has also grown quite close to the President...」

name: Melphas
message: 「If you find yourself curious about him, why not simply do as he suggested.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Acknowledge him, and come to know him...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Surely that will lead to newfound growth for Your Highness.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Or so I was told, which is why...」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yo, Synn! I'm super interested in that deep chasm too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun!? I heard a commotion from the next classroom over, so what is the meaning of this!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nooow then, how about you give us a thorough explanation?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yeah! What's the deal with 'Big Brother'?! I'm way too jealous!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That topic's already over and done with~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Whaaat?! Does that mean I'm done for too?!」

name: Azel
message: 「If you don't know anything, go home.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not taking orders from you, Azel-san, bleh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, Azel's slacking off from the morning again, how naughty.」

name: Misa
message: 「How did you wrap Macaron-san around your finger?! Spill it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have no idea what you're talking about!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is this what you wanted to show me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That you're so popular, surrounded by a harem every day, and living a life fulfilling enough to brag to me about.」

name: Macaron
message: 「So this is the sparkling school life you were talking about, big bro?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah, maybe I really should just invade the Human World after all~」

name: Macaron
message: 「You really are such an idiot, big bro!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is this! What kind of exchange is that!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I have no idea what you're talking about, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「Good grief, it's noisy first thing in the morning.」

name: Helena
message: 「I got so worked up I ended up coming down here to settle things myself.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't quite follow, but thank you for the help...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, you must be the rumored CUTE GIRL! Macaron-chan, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「She's even prettier than I imagined! Nice work, Synn-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm Helena Kujou. I'm Ria Kujou's big sister, and I serve as the Chairwoman of this academy. Nice to meet you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is the Chairwoman even higher up than the Student Council President?」

name: Helena
message: 「If I felt like it, I could destroy the academy overnight--I am the supreme authority here!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother can't even hold a candle to you. The Chairwoman is terrifying...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, just calling me 'Chairwoman' without an honorific is so cold~」

name: Helena
message: 「Mmm~ That really has a nice ring to it!」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone else shouldn't hold back either--follow Macaron-chan's example.」
I wonder what'll happen to Ria-senpai's position.

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, Macaron-chan. Shall we have some tea together so we can get to know each other better?」

name: Helena
message: 「I have a friend who brews truly delicious black tea.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you don't come with me, I'll wreck all sorts of things, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, I'll be taking Macaron-chan off your hands.」

name: Helena
message: 「You all make sure you pay good attention in class~」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, it's been hectic since this morning.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Class is starting. Hurry up and take your seats.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I wanted to thank you for what happened yesterday.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You came all this way just for that? I didn't do anything at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you did take care of me, so.」

name: Melilot
message: 「At any rate, I'm glad to see you've made up.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems Helena was dragging her around, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bringing her straight into the academy is quite the development.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, you've got it all wrong!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I could have sworn the two of you had gotten that close.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone keeps saying the exact same thing...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, things have been quite dangerous lately. It might be best to be careful.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems some sort of rat has snuck into the academy as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, no, just talking to myself. Pay it no mind.」

name: Melilot
message: 「More importantly, if you stay here too long, your lunch break will be over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Have you been stuck keeping Helena-san company this whole time?」

name: Helena
message: 「Would Nanaka-chan prefer something a little softer?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm more than happy with either, though.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「I was simply doting on Macaron-chan. Like I wanted to lick her all over!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So it doesn't even have to be Ria-senpai...」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right--as long as they're cute, even Nanaka-chan will do!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sis Helena is super energetic and fun, so she's fine.」

name: Macaron
message: 「The black tea Big Sis Melilot brews has such a wonderful aroma...」

name: Macaron
message: 「When I asked how to brew it, the lecture just went on forever...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's just a lecture about black tea, it wouldn't hurt to listen, would it?」

name: Helena
message: 「It seems the mail-order goods weren't to her liking.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a hobby of Melilot's. Even shut up in the library, she can still go shopping, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, she ends up with quite a lot of things she stops using.」

name: Helena
message: 「I thought if Macaron-chan liked them, maybe she could take them off her hands, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't want any of that junk!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or maybe take them over to Tame-san's place.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If they were actually useful, that'd be one thing, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't know how to use them, I don't even know if they work, and I don't need to go on a diet either...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, to be frank, she's getting stuck with nothing but shady products!」

name: Macaron
message: 「The massager hurts, the blender is scary, and the vacuum cleaner is loud!」

name: Helena
message: 「Macaron-chan seems to be bad with machines.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, we didn't have anything like that in the Demon World!」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no way I'd know how to use them...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Agh, jeez! That weird machine is so gross...」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it. I can't understand why a machine would do something you can do by hand.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And so, I won't be coming to the academy for a while.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, even though you were so fired up this morning.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whaaat, big brother. Do you want me to stay~?」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu, you really are a heartbreaker, Synn-chan♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「I have a part-time job anyway, so I can't babysit my big brother all day long.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You too, big brother, make sure you do a proper job as president.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~, to think Macaron is worrying about me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Really, isn't she a sweet girl who cares about her big brother.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder about that. Come on, Student Council, Student Council!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, expected nothing less from Mr. President!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... It's probably just Flat-chest pulling some prank anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, it feels like a first-time thing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! So that's what they call a sweet yet embarrassing first experience!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, nothing's gonna start unless we go check it out, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a type I've never seen before, but... it's definitely a Demon.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this counts as a new species discovery!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean 'what should we do,' we're literally being attacked!」

name: Synn
message: 「If they were Macaron's friends, they'd never do something like this!」

name: Ria
message: 「There are a lot of them, so it might be better if we split up to fight.」
